description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


## 中文

- 绘制或编辑直线时，端点会自动吸附到附近直线的端点，方便把线段接在一起。
- 跟随鼠标录屏时，取景框跟随得更及时。鼠标快速移动时，录制区域会尽快把光标纳入画面。
- 截图失败后，应用能重新建立屏幕捕获会话，下次截图无需重启应用。

## English

- Line endpoints snap to nearby line endpoints as you draw or edit, making it easier to join segments.
- The recording outline responds faster in mouse-follow mode. The capture area catches up when the cursor moves quickly.
- After a screen capture failure, the app can reconnect to the display so you can try again without restarting.

## 下载指南 / Download guide

Snow Shot 完整版包含全部功能。Mini 体积更小，保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动文字识别。国内用户可在 [Gitee 发布页](https://gitee.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/tag/v1.5.7_snow-shot) 下载同名文件。

Snow Shot includes all features. Mini is smaller and includes screenshots, annotation, pinned images, collages, recording, and manual text recognition.

## macOS 快速安装 / Quick install

复制一条命令到终端。Apple Silicon 用户安装 Mini 时，在命令末尾加上 `--edition mini`。

Copy either command into Terminal. For Mini on Apple Silicon, append `--edition mini`.

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://gitee.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.5.7_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
```
